good: Immediate action hook: dynamic fighting/impact visible in first frame stops scrolling
Clear fighter identification and KO result: text overlay provides instant context
Solid viewer retention: 5.7s average watch time indicates content holds attention
Professional production with UFC branding adds legitimacy
bad: Critical low save rate (0.1%): content isn't sticky/rewatchable despite good watch time
Weak share performance (0.2% of views): doesn't trigger the 'must share' impulse
Text overlay lacks celebratory impact: clinical delivery undercuts the dramatic moment
No reaction shot or slow-mo amplification at KO impact to drive emotional resonance
reels.top_tip: Add a reaction shot or slow-motion replay of the finish with more emotionally driven overlay text (e.g., 'FINISHED!' rather than clinical result) — you're holding viewers but failing to make them want to share it
